comment: Lab Tuner fun metrics (docs/LAB_TUNER.md Part 3). Edit freely: targets are starting guesses. metrics: target [low, high] (null = no limit on that side), weight in the fun score, scale = how far outside the target counts as 0. realChoiceBand: an option within this share of the best counts as a real choice; obviousGap: a turn is obvious when the best leads the second by more than this share; valueUnit: the smallest value the shares are taken of (1 = about 1 HP). closeWinHp: a win is close when the party's total HP fell under this share. dominantIgnore: plays left out of the dominant card count (the built-in Strike isn't a card). complexity: the fun score loses complexityWeight x (sum of learnCost of levers turned on) / complexityNorm. hardLimits disqualify a lever set whatever its score (minFightExpertWin: in the final robustness check, the expert must win this share of every fight). effectEpsilon: a lever helps or hurts when it moves the fun score by more than this. parties: party compositions for robustness (balanced = the fight's own party). teamworkOps: card ops that count as teammate-deck plays. stallRounds/maxSteps: the sweep watchdog.
